verbatim_quote.original: Task 263 acceptance criteria in brief: (1) the transcript sent to the model is bounded by an env-configurable cap, blank-means-unset, with a documented default; (2) when the transcript is cut, the prompt carries an explicit note stating how much was dropped; (3) a malformed, zero or negative cap value fails the turn loudly with `ValueError`; (4) the decision-server config readers that today silently clamp (`_get_decision_max_tokens`, `_get_decision_temperature`) fail loudly instead; (5) the Responses API request shape stays as it is (already conformant); (6) regression tests cover default, blank, override, malformed, zero/negative and the truncation note; (7) the full suite stays green.

extracted_decision.summary: Set seven acceptance criteria for task 263 covering bounded transcript, truncation note, loud config validation, unchanged request shape, regression tests, and green suite.
